correctness.rationale: Headline is a positive exact-arithmetic certificate: explicit affine Q-points p1=(1,2,0),p2=(2,1,0),p3=(0,0,0),p4=(1,0,0),p5=(2,0,1),p6=(0,0,3),p7=(-1,1,1),p8=(0,1,1),p9=(7,11,13) realize M8- (V8 relaxed at 5678) and its free 9-point extension M9+. Re-ran inputs/artifacts/verify_m9.py (exact Fraction): VERIFY_OK, bases=122 pos=73 neg=49. Independently re-implemented 4x4 determinants by permutation expansion: dependent 4-sets on {1..8} are exactly {1234,1256,3456,3478}, det(5678)=2, so column matroid has precisely V8 bases plus 5678; by the circuit-hyperplane relaxation theorem this is the matroid M8-, rank 4, no basis-exchange search needed. On 9 points dependent 4-sets are still exactly those four; no 4-set containing 9 is dependent. Affine identity p9=-16p5+6p6-39p7+50p8 with coefficients summing to 1 verified exactly; since {5,6,7,8} is a basis its span is the whole rank-4 space, so the 'principal extension in span{5,6,7,8}' is the free/generic extension, a matroid of rank 4 -- wording is loose but mathematically sound. Simplicity verified two ways: affine no-collinear-triple check returns [] and linear rank of every 2- and 3-subset is full (no loops/parallel). Contraction M9+/9: {9,1,2,3} has det -39 != 0 so projection from 9 is defined over Q; change-of-basis projection in script is standard linear algebra and {1,5,7} has nonzero projected 3x3 determinant, so contraction has rank 3 and is Q-realized. Realizable over ordered field Q => orientable via determinant-sign chirotope is a correct inference; sign split read off the same exact table. Limitations are stated honestly (no final polynomial needed for positive verdict; no catalogue IDs; only generic placement; search code not part of certificate). This is proof by exact certificate, not experimental evidence.
